items.title: From software to Self-Ware: beyond the one-prompt miracle
items.summary: AI coding agents have unlocked "Software for One" (Self-Ware): bespoke apps built by one engineer for an audience of one.Presented at the Agentic Coding Meetup in Hamburg, this deck tells the story of building LimeLight (the native macOS presentation app running this very talk). I walk through why chasing the "one-prompt miracle" fails even when you have a full PRD, AGENTS.md, skills, and 26,500 lines of green tests, and how iterative engineering spikes combined with Systems Design, Taste, and Grit actually ship real software with coding agents.
